headline: Japan Benchmark Bond Yields Rise Ahead of BOJ and Fed Decisions
summary: Japanese benchmark bond yields edged higher as markets awaited monetary policy decisions from both the Bank of Japan and the US Federal Reserve.
why: Japanese Government Bonds serve as the foundational risk-free benchmark for domestic lending and influence global fixed-income flows.

impacts.name: Japanese Government Bonds
impacts.why: Yields rise when bond prices fall due to cautious positioning ahead of central bank meetings.
